script.title: Why AI needs more than a giant memory
sentences: If an AI can accept a huge document, does that mean it understands every line perfectly?
A context window describes how much input a model can process in a particular interaction, not guaranteed comprehension.
Important details can still be overlooked, confused, or mixed with information from another part of the material.
The task, document structure, and location of relevant evidence can all affect the usefulness of the answer.
For careful work, ask focused questions and require quotations that can be checked against the original text.
You can also divide the job into smaller sections before combining the findings with human review.
More available context is useful capacity, but capacity and reliable use of evidence are different things.
Would you test an assistant with one long question or several focused ones?

script.title: How a brain implant reads a movement intention
sentences: Can a brain implant read every private thought in your head?
Not in the way that science-fiction mind reading suggests, because these systems measure limited signals from particular locations.
Researchers can train decoders to connect patterns of neural activity with a task such as attempted movement.
That can help some participants control a cursor or another device under specific experimental conditions.
The decoder’s performance depends on the sensors, training data, participant, and task it was built for.
Surgery, device durability, signal changes, and long-term support are important issues beyond a successful demonstration.
Turning an intention into a command is remarkable, but it does not establish unrestricted access to someone’s inner life.
Which issue matters most to you: privacy, reliability, or surgical risk?
